description.value:
You target an unenhanced flame within a 5-foot cube that you can see and within range, snuffing it out, and choose one of the following effects.

Fireworks. The extinguished flame erupts into a blinding burst of color. Every creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn.

Smoke. Dense black smoke billows outward in a 20-foot radius, curling around corners and heavily obscuring the area. The cloud persists for up to 1 minute or until scattered by a strong wind.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
